sharedSafariTours.description: A safari experience where travelers from different bookings or tour companies are grouped together in the same vehicle to explore Tanzania's national parks
sharedSafariTours.purpose: Budget-friendly and sociable way to experience Tanzania's national parks
sharedSafariTours.concept: Travelers split the cost of vehicle, guide, and fuel while following individual itineraries and accommodation bookings

vehicleCapacity.seating: Everyone has a window seat with enough space for comfort and viewing

howItWorks.grouping: Travelers grouped with others whose itineraries closely match in terms of park visits and safari dates
howItWorks.accommodation: Each client accommodated according to their own itinerary (budget campsite, mid-range lodge, or luxury tented lodge)
howItWorks.dropOff: Guests dropped off at their specific hotel or camp
howItWorks.guide: Fully guided by professional driver-guide provided by Zanzi Trekking and Safaris or Partner Company
howItWorks.experience: All benefits of guided safari experience at a more accessible price

benefits.description: Split the cost of transportation and guide services with others. Ideal for solo travelers or couples who want to keep costs down without compromising on experience
Meet fellow travelers from around the world. Exchange stories, share excitement of wildlife sightings, and make new friends during journey
For solo travelers - experience journey with others, making it more fun, engaging, and safe. Likely make new friends and never feel isolated
Accommodation, meal plan, and travel schedule still based on what you booked - no need to compromise on preferred level of comfort

qualityAssurance.coordination: Carefully coordinated logistics for smooth experience
qualityAssurance.standards: Same professionalism, safety standards, and local expertise as private safaris

importantNotes: Well-organized but involve a bit of flexibility with pickup times and coordination
While sharing vehicle, guests enjoy their own room and lodge based on booking level (budget, mid-range, or luxury)
Safari activities, meals, and accommodations tailored to individual itinerary
Don't lose personal experience - just share the ride
targetAudience: Social travelers who enjoy meeting new people
Flexible travelers open to shared experiences

kenya.description: Experience the legendary Masai Mara and stunning Rift Valley landscapes

routes.description: Distance depends on the Mara Camp/Mara Hotel location. Travel time is 5 hours 30 minutes with bathroom stops. Speed limit is 60-80 km/h for tourist vehicles. Paved roads from Nairobi to Narok; final stretch to park is unpaved and may be slower depending on weather and road surface
Combination of paved and murram roads. Travel time may vary based on route choices and regional traffic conditions
Smooth highway with regular traffic flow. Travel time may increase near Nairobi due to urban traffic congestion
Fully paved route. Border formalities at Namanga may influence overall travel duration depending on processing times

tanzania.description: Explore the iconic Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, and diverse wildlife parks

routes.description: Paved route with light to moderate traffic. Drive passes through scenic countryside and towns
Route includes travel through Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Roads vary from paved to gravel, with elevation changes and gate procedures
Paved and well-maintained road via Karatu and Mto wa Mbu, transitioning from highlands to Rift Valley floor
Good tarmac road. Travel times may fluctuate depending on local traffic, especially when approaching Arusha
Roads vary from paved highways to gravel tracks through Ngorongoro area. Entry logistics and terrain influence timing
Combination of paved highways and conservation area roads through Ngorongoro. Duration depends on routing and park access schedules
routes.roadCondition: Mixed - paved highways and conservation roads

routes.description: Short paved drive with steady elevation gain
Direct drive from Ngorongoro to Tarangire offering scenic views across diverse landscapes
Includes crater rim roads and tarmac highways through towns. Travel time may vary depending on road use and stopovers
routes.roadCondition: Mixed - crater rim roads and tarmac highways

notes.note: Drive times are approximate and based on typical road and weather conditions. Allow extra time for unexpected delays
Travel durations may vary with weather, road maintenance, park procedures, border formalities, and local traffic
Traffic congestion is more likely near major urban centers such as Nairobi and Arusha, especially during peak hours
Early morning departures are often recommended for smoother travel and optimal park entry timing

additionalInfo.peakHours: Urban centers like Nairobi and Arusha

marangu.name: Marangu Route
marangu.description: Mount Kilimanjaro, standing at 5,895 meters (19,341 feet), is Africa's tallest mountain. Unlike many high-altitude peaks, Kilimanjaro doesn't require technical climbing skills—what you need is determination, proper acclimatization, and the right route
keyFeatures: Only route with dormitory-style hut accommodation instead of camping
No technical climbing required, suitable for first-time trekkers
Steady elevation gain helps with acclimatization

fiveDay.note: Times may vary based on climber's fitness level, experience, and acclimatization. Weather conditions and individual pace can affect completion times

sixDay.note: The 6-day itinerary includes an extra acclimatization day at Horombo Hut, which significantly increases your chances of reaching the summit

tourOffering.description: Our company offers expert-led tours along the Marangu Route, ensuring a safe and comfortable experience tailored to your preferences
